messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated gateway timeouts (504) and backend timeouts across us-east-1. Window=7m, error_rate=6.2% (>4%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Dashboards: https://internal.redwood/d/gw-timeouts | Pager: @alice_oncall @bob_sre

alice_oncall: taking this — paging SREs. assigning priority=P1. Starting triage.

bob_sre: oncall here. grabbing logs and tracing. can someone confirm any customer-reported impacts?

dan_support: seeing 12 customer tickets in last 10m, most report sudden timeouts and retries. Top affected: embeddings-heavy clients, some webhook customers.

emma_obs: looking at traces — sampling low and a chunk of traces appear without span IDs at the gateway->model-proxy hop. Many requests show no X-Request-ID forwarded. Also trace-sampling=10% so coverage is noisy.

carla_eng: that matches my quick look at access logs. nginx ingress sometimes drops the request-id when a circuit path hits the external LB. I want to roll a temporary probe: increase trace sampling and add lightweight debug env to gateway to forward headers and emit request ids to stdout.

alice_oncall: go for probe. note: keep changes reversible and avoid long-lived high sampling.

carla_eng: applying hotpatch now:
```bash
kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/gateway PROBE_DEBUG=true TRACE_SAMPLING=100
kubectl -n gateway rollout restart deploy/gateway
```
deploy-bot: deploy/gateway rollout started (deploy/gateway) — initiated by carla_eng. status: progressing.

alice_oncall: running curl test against /v1/generate to reproduce.
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://gw.us-east-1.redwood/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout (repeatable)

bob_sre: pulled gateway logs after probe started. sample:
```
[2026-03-15T04:12:03Z] INFO incoming request id= - missing header X-Request-ID
[2026-03-15T04:12:03Z] WARN backend connection timed out after 60s route=/v1/generate
```
we still have a subset where request id is blank. suspecting LB -> ingress header rewrite.

emma_obs: adding temporary trace shim at model-proxy to synthesize a trace id when header missing and emit a span with correlation metadata. Patching now.

carla_eng: hotpatching ingress config to ensure header passthrough: adding `proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id;` to nginx template and increasing internal log level for 30m. Patch:
```yaml
# patch snippet
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  nginx.conf: |
    proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $request_id;
    proxy_set_header X-B3-TraceId $request_id;
```
kubectl -n ingress apply -f nginx-hotpatch.yaml && kubectl -n ingress rollout restart deploy/ingress-nginx
```

dan_support: drafting customer message: "We're aware of increased timeouts for some requests in us-east-1. Our engineering team is actively mitigating; recommended short-term workaround: retry with exponential backoff for 10-30s." will send ops-safe comms to top customers after confirm.

lily_pm: ETA on stable fix? blocking for customers.

alice_oncall: short-term: full trace sampling + header passthrough probe to capture root cause — estimate 1.5-2h to verify and roll stable config. if we see regressions, revert probe.

emma_obs: after shim and ingress patch we captured correlated spans for ~70% of recent 504s. Still ~30% with no backend spans — likely a race in LB health/connection reuse. adding temporary logging at LB (via cloud provider console) for 20m to capture raw TCP/front-proxy behavior.

bob_sre: found patterns — high connection churn coinciding with a spike in KVCache evictions on model-proxy (memory pressure spikes). when the proxy evicts, requests stall leading to gateway timeouts. KVCache metrics: evictions spike 3x at same timestamps.

carla_eng: enabling KVCache debug metrics and a guard: throttle concurrency to model-proxy to reduce pressure. quick patch: set MAX_CONN=120 from 300 on model-proxy pods and restart one deployment at a time.

carla_eng: applying conn limit:
```bash
kubectl -n models set env deploy/model-proxy MAX_CONN=120 && kubectl -n models rollout restart deploy/model-proxy --max-unavailable=1
```

alice_oncall: monitoring impact. if timeouts drop, we keep throttle and schedule a follow-up to tune cache and memory sizing.

deploy-bot: deploy/model-proxy rollout succeeded.

emma_obs: after throttle, 504 rate dropped from 6.2% -> 1.1% in 12m. trace coverage improved due to fewer evictions; ingress headers appear consistent.

dan_support: customer impact update: out of 12 tickets, 9 moved to "mitigated" after client-side retry guidance. preparing outbound update for affected customers.

lily_pm: thanks. please ensure postmortem includes timeline, root cause (kvcache evictions -> connection churn), and follow-ups (memory tuning, long-term header passthrough test).

alice_oncall: agreed. creating incident ticket and postmortem checklist. handing to bob_sre for overnight monitoring and follow-ups.

bob_sre: taking handoff for 04:00-12:00UTC. action items: 1) revert TRACE_SAMPLING to default after 30m 2) run heap/profile on model-proxy 3) create autoscale alert for KVCache evictions 4) coordinate with infra for LB connection settings. linking runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/gateway-timeouts

alice_oncall: done — leaving notes in ticket and adding postmortem owner=carla_eng. :white_check_mark: :pager:
